title: How to create a no-code web3 app on Algorand
summary: Read how to create a no-code web3 app on the Algorand blockchain by adding using the DropChain API to any app made in Bubble.io, Wix or any other no-code app builder.
author: Carter Razink
body:
Building a web3 app on the Algorand blockchain can be a challenging task for even the most experienced web developers. The process is time-consuming and requires a deep understanding of smart contract development, programming, and blockchain infrastructure. But with DropChain, you can create a no-code web3 app without the steep learning curve.

DropChain is a web3 development suite that gives existing web2 applications web3 functionality. DropChain provides easy-to-use APIs, pre-built smart contracts, and Single Sign-On (SSO) integration.

It's the perfect solution for developers, even those who may have never programmed or built any kind of app before, looking to quickly and easily create web3 applications or games without the need to learn a new smart contract language or navigate the complexities of blockchain infrastructure.

Here's a simple three-step process for building your own no-code web3 game with DropChain:

Step 1: Build

The first step in building a web3 app on Algorand is to create a front-end interface. This can be done using no-code tools like Bubble.io, Wix, or FlutterFlow. These tools allow you to create your app in any programming language or no-code app builder. Anything that accepts APIs will do. This step is critical as it allows you to create a user-friendly interface that will be the foundation of your app.

We have created a full guide about how to build a no-code web3 app with Bubble.io in our documentation. We walk you through everything about building a web3 app on Bubble.io from start to finish. Plus, if you have any questions about the process, join our Discord and ask questions to fellow web3 developers!

Step 2: Enhance

The second step is to enhance your web app with web3 functionality by integrating the DropChain API. This can be done through our REST API, which allows you to add pre-made smart contracts to your app without any web3 experience. The DropChain API gives your application the ability to mint NFTs, send and receive digital assets, and deploy and interact with pre-made smart contracts. This step is critical as it allows you to launch a web3 application fast, instead of spending countless hours and days building smart contracts from scratch.

Step 3: Integrate

The third step is to integrate the DropChain SSO to onboard anyone onto your web3 application using conventional web2 credentials. This step is critical as it makes your app easy to use, which is crucial for reaching mass adoption. With DropChain, anyone can use your app.

In summary, building a web3 app on Algorand using DropChain can cut down on development time for new web3 builders. It eliminates the need for web3 experience and provides pre-made smart contracts, making it a superior option for building and launching a web3 application quickly and easily.
